checks.name: token identity
checks.sql: SELECT team_id, team, bot_id FROM slack.main.auth_info()

checks.name: token is redacted
checks.sql: SELECT options['token'] FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE database_name = 'slack'

checks.name: channels page
checks.sql: SELECT id, name, is_private FROM slack.main.channels() ORDER BY id

checks.name: history spans pages
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), min(text), max(text) FROM slack.main.messages('#general')

checks.name: time bounds
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM slack.main.messages('#general', oldest := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:10:00+00')

checks.name: timestamps
checks.sql: SELECT ts, epoch_us(posted_at) FROM slack.main.messages('#general') LIMIT 1

checks.name: thread
checks.sql: SELECT text FROM slack.main.replies('#general', '1767225900.000100') ORDER BY ts

checks.name: join users
checks.sql: SELECT u.real_name, count(*) FROM slack.main.messages('#general') m JOIN slack.main.users() u ON u.id = m.user_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC

checks.name: post per row, multi-batch
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT ts) FROM slack.main.post_messages((SELECT 'G0SECRET' AS channel, 'row ' || i AS text, '1767225600.000001' AS thread_ts FROM range(3000) t(i)))
